file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

old_string.description: The exact text to replace, sent with new_string; unique in the file unless replace_all

new_string.description: The text to replace it with; "" deletes old_string

expected_anchor.description: The bare fa:… or ra:… value inside the latest "(anchor: …)" for this file — a Read, or an Edit or Write result — without the wrapper

hunks.description: Line-addressed hunks against the snapshot expected_anchor names, or against the content anchors when every hunk carries one

lines.description: A 1-based line ("12"), an inclusive range ("12-18"), or the anchored spelling from a line_anchors read ("12#ab3f", "12#ab3f-18#9c2e")

replace.description: The replacement body; "" deletes the range; with insert, the inserted body

insert.description: Insert beside the single anchor line instead of replacing it

append.description: Text added on its own line at the end of the file (created when absent; no prior read needed), or at the end of `section`

section.description: A Markdown heading line exactly as it stands in the file ("## Checks"), occurring once: with new_string the whole section, heading included, becomes new_string; with append the text is added inside it

description: One of four shapes: old_string + new_string · hunks · append · section + new_string or append
